THE EXAMINATION, EXPLAINED

Papers & components.

Choose the year you will sit the exam. The weighting applies to the qualification and route selected below.

EXAMINATION YEAR 2027ROUTE Full A Level
Assessment components · 9695 · 2027 · Full A Level
ComponentDurationMarksWeighting
PAPER 1Drama and Poetry2h5025%
PAPER 2Prose and Unseen2h5025%
PAPER 3Shakespeare and Drama2h5025%
PAPER 4Pre- and Post-1900 Poetry and Prose2h5025%

Full A Level comprises Papers 1–4, each worth 25%. AS carry-forward is subject to Cambridge’s rules. All papers are externally assessed and closed text. Choose set texts for your examination year.

Drama and Poetry — component 1+

One drama response and one poetry response; 25 marks each.

Prose and Unseen — component 2+

One prose response and one unseen response; 25 marks each.

Shakespeare and Drama — component 3+

One Shakespeare response and one other drama response; 25 marks each.

Pre- and Post-1900 Poetry and Prose — component 4+

Write one essay on a pre-1900 set text and one on a post-1900 set text. One must be on poetry and the other on prose. Each is worth 25 marks. For each set text, choose an essay question or a question based on a printed passage or poem.

A PURPOSE FOR EVERY LESSON

What you’ll work on.

01

Interpretation with depth

Explore alternative readings and explain why the textual evidence supports them.

02

Literary craft

Analyse the relationship between language, form and structure.

03

A sustained argument

Bring your knowledge of a text into a focused, independent response.
